Review redacted app and network activity

Stored only on this device, separately for the active instance and account. The journal contains redacted network metadata, app exit reasons and predefined SABR failure categories. A crash report keeps exception class names, method names and line numbers, but never exception messages. Session IDs are replaced with local fingerprints. URLs, search terms, video IDs, headers, cookies, tokens, request bodies and raw server messages are never recorded.

The server accepts reports from signed-in member accounts. You can still share the local diagnostic export manually.
Diagnostic preview attached: API errors %1$d, app events %2$d.

Only the category, your description, the app and Android versions, redacted routes, HTTP status codes, timings and safe request IDs are included. No video ID, search, host, token, cookie, request body, exception message or stack trace is attached.
The report is sent to the selected TypeType instance for its administrators to review. It does not create a public GitHub issue.
Save watched videos and playback progress

While a member account is active, the app reports a random installation ID and current non-live playback to the selected TypeType instance. It does not send a hardware ID, account email, network name or private host, and reporting failures never interrupt playback.
